About me

Software developer with a soft spot for the modern web.

Building things that ship

I'm Angel Fraga, a software developer focused on the frontend and the boundaries around it — Angular, TypeScript and authoring the backend that fits. I care about performance, accessibility and code that the next person actually enjoys reading.

When I'm not shipping, I write about the craft: design systems, monorepos, desktop apps and where AI genuinely helps a working developer. This site is where all of that lands.
